text:
You undress just as if you were alone

and suddenly discover you're with me.

How I love you then

among the sheets and the cold!


You start flirting with me as with a stranger

and I court you formally and halfheartedly.

I think I'm your husband

and you're cheating on me with me.


And how we love each other then, laughing

to find ourselves alone in forbidden love!


(Afterward, when it's over, I'm afraid of you

and shiver.)

translation.title: You Undress Just As
